subject: Sunrise Supplies — invoice delivery method and CSV header walkthrough
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@sunrise-supplies.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <accounts@sunrise-supplies.com>
Date: 2028-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding question — invoice channel and file headers

Hi Vanessa,

We're getting closer to go-live and want to confirm the preferred invoice path for Redwood accounts. Our AP team can either: (A) upload invoices to your vendor portal (we'd need a vendor account + SSO instruction), or (B) email invoices to a dedicated ingestion address.

A couple of specific questions:
- If we email invoices, do you require a PO number in the subject line? If so, exact format?
- Do you prefer PDF invoices or CSV with line items? If CSV, can you share the expected header row?
- Any remit or VAT fields we should include for EU shipments?

I attached our current onboarding form and a sample CSV to show how we usually send line items. Happy to adapt — just want to avoid rework.

Thanks,

Liam O'Neill
Head of Finance Operations
Sunrise Supplies
attachments: sunrise_onboarding_form.pdf (form, 125KB), invoice_sample.csv (csv, 2KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@sunrise-supplies.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding question — invoice channel and file headers

Hi Liam — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the attachments. Short answers up front: both paths are supported, but we prefer portal-first for new vendors. Below are the tradeoffs and our ask so we can finalize today.

Portal (recommended):
- Best for automation: PO matching, acknowledgements, and idempotency.
- Request: one account admin user + billing contact.
- No subject token required. Files can be PDF or CSV; CSV gives better line-item fidelity.

Email ingestion (fallback):
- Good for low-volume vendors or when portal onboarding is delayed.
- We require PO in the email subject line, formatted as: PO#<10-digit-number> (example: PO#0000123456).
- Include vendor ID in the first line of the body if you have it.

CSV header guidance (if you choose CSV):
- Required columns (exact header names): invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, sku, description, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount, currency, remit_address
- Optional for EU VAT: vat_number, vat_rate
- Line items should be one row per SKU; totals should be included as grand_total in the final row or as a separate summary column.

Next steps:
1) If portal: I'll loop in Kimberly (vendor onboarding) to schedule SSO setup and an admin invite.
2) If email: please confirm you'll add PO#1234567890 in subject for your test file and use the header names above.

Kimberly — can you pick up portal invitation once Liam confirms? Jordan — tagging you in case we need a short exception for multi-entity POs.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0134

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@sunrise-supplies.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-09T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding question — invoice channel and file headers

Thanks Vanessa. Liam — quick operational notes from onboarding: 

- Portal invite: we typically create the vendor admin, then send an SSO link that expires in 7 days. We'll need company legal name and the primary admin email (if you want me to create the account, I'll use liam.oneill@sunrise-supplies.com).
- PO stamping: For portal uploads we auto-extract PO numbers from either the file metadata or the invoice body; no special subject token needed. For email ingestion, please use Vanessa's PO# format — our parser is strict about "PO#" prefix.
- Edge case: if your invoices have multiple POs (split billing across entities), include a po_split column in the CSV and tag each line item with its PO. We'll need a short mapping doc; I can draft one.

I'll attach a minimal CSV template and the onboarding checklist to this thread — they show the exact header row Vanessa listed. Let me know if you want us to validate a sample file before go-live.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference

1) We'll sign up for the portal. Please create the vendor admin with liam.oneill@sunrise-supplies.com.
2) We're going to run one test via email first to exercise PO subject parsing. We'll send a test email with subject: PO#0000123456 and attach invoice_sample.csv (headers updated to match your required names).

Attached here is the updated CSV sample (invoice_sample.csv) — we changed invoice_date to YYYY-MM-DD and added a vat_number column. If you can run a quick sanity check once you get the test, that would be ideal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best regards,
